description: This file defines the class ArrayCsrfTokenStorage, which implements the TokenStorageInterface to manage CSRF tokens in an array-based storage for testing purposes. It includes methods to get, set, remove, and check existence of tokens, and is part of a test suite within the namespace OrangeHRM\Tests\Util\Mock.

classes.name: ArrayCsrfTokenStorage
classes.description: A mock implementation of TokenStorageInterface that stores CSRF tokens in an internal array for testing purposes.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the CSRF token associated with the given token ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Associates a CSRF token with a token ID.

methods.name: removeToken
methods.description: Removes the CSRF token for the given token ID and returns it, or null if none exists.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks whether a CSRF token exists for the given token ID.
